access.name: Local admin rights
access.reason: Install approved dependencies and configure IIS.

access.name: AWS / VPN role group
access.reason: Reach Dealertrack development resources through the approved VPN.
access.evidence: New-hire request and VPN guide; EM must confirm group

access.name: Confluence
access.reason: Read team documentation and workstation instructions.

access.name: DT onboarding SharePoint folder
access.reason: Access supplemental setup material when needed.
access.evidence: Guide links to folder; request route unconfirmed

access.name: Database / application test user
access.reason: Obtain approved connection details and a suitable application test user.
access.evidence: Guide and Local Setup blocker; owner/entitlements need EM confirmation

steps.name: Check workstation prerequisites
steps.action: Run scripts/Test-OnboardingReadiness.ps1. It inspects local state and writes a report.
steps.verification: Review every missing, blocked, and unverified result.

steps.name: Install the 32-bit Oracle client
steps.action: Use the approved installer with Oracle Base C:\Oracle.
steps.verification: Expected client directory and Oracle network configuration exist.

steps.name: Run the existing workstation setup
steps.action: Review the current setup.bat before running as Administrator. Git LFS assets must be hydrated.
steps.verification: Check actual installed files and IIS configuration; script completion alone is insufficient.

steps.name: Configure JFrog and restore packages
steps.action: Authenticate using the approved JFrog flow; configure the feed locally without sharing tokens.
steps.verification: Restore the agreed Core/Status projects using Visual Studio tooling.

steps.name: Import and connect the VPN profile
steps.action: Use AS24 Okta and the approved endpoint profile.
steps.verification: Confirm connection and access to required development resources.

steps.name: Build Core and Status
steps.action: Confirm the intended QA branches with the team and build using Visual Studio MSBuild.
steps.verification: Required projects build; record targeting-pack or dependency failures.

steps.name: Verify local application readiness
steps.action: Open the portal, Status, and Create App. Use 127.0.0.1 for the known local IPv6 issue.
steps.verification: With team permission in a test environment, save an application and find its ID in Status.
